sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः ।क्रोधामाहारयत्तीव्रं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ।। ७.६९.१ ॥
transliteration: tacchrutvā bhāṣitaṁ tasya śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ ।krodhāmāhārayattīvraṁ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt ।। 7.69.1 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that speech of the great-souled Shatrughna, he felt intense anger and exclaimed, "Stop! Stop!"
